items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: If you got pushed for some money on the road, you could always go to Mister Wright, who we called our Daddy.

ctx.x: And there I was out there floundering around, and there Danny Barker was in New York, and he said, "What you doin'?" And I said "Nothing." And he said, "Well, come with me." And then what do you do? I took my bass and he took his guitar, and we got on the subway, and I wound up in Hoboken, New Jersey, with Danny Barker, and he says, "Come on with me..." Tell him about it, Danny.
We did the big ones and the small ones. We'd go out there... I just want to say this. You see, what...
